import hashlib,json,re,statistics
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
from legal_skill_guard.experiment.storage import RunStore
ROOT=Path("/media/sangfor/vdb/legal-skill-evolve")
def read(p): return json.loads((ROOT/p).read_text())
def sha(p): return hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def iso(t): return datetime.fromtimestamp(t,timezone.utc).isoformat()
main="runs/legal_openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03"
costpath="artifacts/research/openexempt_legal_scope_20261020/Run03_complete_B1_B8_actual_terminal1158_15_cost_20261022.json"
curvepath="artifacts/research/openexempt_legal_scope_20261020/Run03_learning_curve_complete_first8_final8_publications_20261022.json"
cost=read(costpath)
assert len(cost["all1158_raw_origins"])==len(set(cost["all1158_raw_origins"]))==1158
allspans={i:[] for i in range(1,9)}
for rawpath in cost["all1158_raw_origins"]:
    p=ROOT/rawpath
    raw=read(rawpath)
    assert raw["transport_error"] is None and len(raw["calls"])==1
    response=raw["calls"][0]["response"]
    assert response["choices"][0]["finish_reason"]=="stop"
    start=p.with_suffix(".input.json").stat().st_mtime
    end=p.stat().st_mtime
    created=response["created"]
    assert start-1.1<=created<=end and end>=start
    batch=int(re.match(r"b(\d+)_",raw["stage"]).group(1))
    allspans[batch].append({"path":rawpath,"stage":raw["stage"],"family":raw["family"],
        "start":start,"end":end,"server_created_seconds":created,
        "input_tokens":response["usage"]["prompt_tokens"],
        "output_tokens":response["usage"]["completion_tokens"]})
rows=[]
previous=None
for batch,spans in allspans.items():
    spans.sort(key=lambda z:z["start"])
    pubpath=f"{main}/publications/b{batch}.json"
    pub=read(pubpath)
    end=datetime.fromisoformat(pub["at"]).timestamp()
    start=previous if previous is not None else spans[0]["start"]
    wall=end-start
    assert all(z["start"]>=start-0.01 and z["end"]<=end+0.01 for z in spans)
    assert all(spans[i]["start"]>=spans[i-1]["end"]-0.01 for i in range(1,len(spans)))
    stages={k:v for k,v in cost["actual_native_stage_totals"].items()
            if re.match(r"b(\d+)_",k).group(1)==str(batch)}
    teachers=[z for z in cost["all15_actual_fresh_teacher_response_usages"]
              if re.match(r"b(\d+)_",z["stage"]).group(1)==str(batch)]
    native=sum(z["end"]-z["start"] for z in spans)
    teacher=sum(z["response_elapsed_seconds"] for z in teachers)
    output=sum(z["output_tokens"] for z in spans)
    assert output==sum(z["output_tokens"] for z in stages.values())
    first=sum(z["generations"] for k,z in stages.items() if k.endswith("_prequential"))
    between=sorted([{"seconds":spans[i]["start"]-spans[i-1]["end"],
                      "previous_stage":spans[i-1]["stage"],"next_stage":spans[i]["stage"]}
                    for i in range(1,len(spans))],key=lambda z:z["seconds"],reverse=True)
    rows.append({"batch":batch,"start_at_UTC":iso(start),"publication_at_UTC":pub["at"],
        "start_definition":"previous actual publication" if previous is not None
            else "first native input-file mtime, not inferred systemd launch",
        "elapsed_seconds":wall,"native_original_generations":len(spans),
        "first_forecast_original_generations":first,
        "candidate_replay_original_generations":len(spans)-first,
        "native_input_tokens":sum(z["input_tokens"] for z in spans),
        "native_output_tokens":output,"native_stage_totals":stages,
        "native_input_to_raw_completion_file_intervals_seconds":native,
        "native_file_interval_share":native/wall,
        "output_tokens_per_file_interval_second_not_GPU_decode_speed":output/native,
        "teacher_recorded_response_seconds":teacher,
        "unassigned_residual_seconds_not_measured_GPU_idle":wall-native-teacher,
        "largest_three_between_native_file_intervals":between[:3],
        "native_interval_median_seconds":statistics.median(z["end"]-z["start"] for z in spans),
        "native_interval_max_seconds":max(z["end"]-z["start"] for z in spans),
        "publication_file":pubpath,"publication_sha256":sha(pubpath),
        "all_native_file_interval_observations_sha256":
            hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(spans,sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":")).encode()).hexdigest()})
    previous=end
assert sum(z["native_original_generations"] for z in rows)==1158
assert sum(z["first_forecast_original_generations"] for z in rows)==550
assert sum(z["candidate_replay_original_generations"] for z in rows)==608
assert sum(z["native_output_tokens"] for z in rows)==3232344
tot={"elapsed_seconds_from_first_native_input_to_final_publication":sum(z["elapsed_seconds"] for z in rows),
     "original_generations":1158,"first_forecast_generations":550,"replay_generations":608,
     "input_tokens":sum(z["native_input_tokens"] for z in rows),
     "output_tokens":3232344,
     "native_file_intervals_seconds":sum(z["native_input_to_raw_completion_file_intervals_seconds"] for z in rows),
     "teacher_recorded_response_seconds":sum(z["teacher_recorded_response_seconds"] for z in rows),
     "unassigned_residual_seconds":sum(z["unassigned_residual_seconds_not_measured_GPU_idle"] for z in rows)}
assert tot["input_tokens"]==7655443
verified=[]
for frozen in ("configs/openexempt_closed_feedback_public_assets128_20261021_run03.frozen.json",
               "configs/openexempt_ace_public_assets128_20261021_run01.frozen.json"):

                     "all_bound_file_bytes_unchanged":True})
handles=[]
for pid,ticks,needle in ((3613253,"446037091","vllm"),
                          (1738522,"455481667","experiments.openexempt_ace_online")):
    p=Path(f"/proc/{pid}")

        hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(argv).encode()).hexdigest(),"original_handle_still_running":True})
